description: This file contains tests for the DeepLinkAgentPolicy component, verifying message validation and delivery logic based on various link configurations.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPolicyTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test functions for DeepLinkAgentPolicy behavior.

methods.name: validate message for handle rejects too long when unkeyed
methods.description: Tests that messages exceeding the maximum length are rejected when 'allowUnattended' is false.

methods.name: validate message for handle allows too long when keyed
methods.description: Tests that long messages are accepted when 'allowUnattended' is true.

methods.name: effective delivery ignores delivery fields when unkeyed
methods.description: Verifies that certain delivery fields are ignored when the link key is nil.

methods.name: effective delivery honors deliver for deliverable channels when keyed
methods.description: Checks that delivery settings are honored when the link is configured with a key and the channel is deliverable.

methods.name: effective delivery still blocks web chat delivery when keyed
methods.description: Ensures web chat delivery is blocked even when the link is keyed.
